Heh... well, let's just say... we specialize in 'legally complex' matters... catch my drift?|Fizz}} '''Fizz''' is an employee of the [[Setting#Joja Corporation|Joja Corporation]] working in the "Joja Special Services Division". He sends a letter inviting the player to meet him in the "watery cave" on Ginger Island the day after they have interacted with the [[Qi's Walnut Room#Perfection Tracker|Perfection Tracker]] in [[Qi's Walnut Room]] for the first time. The "watery cave" is the [[Ginger Island#Dig Site|Mushroom Cave]] on [[Ginger Island]], where [[Professor Snail]] is first found. There he sells Perfection Waivers for {{Price|500000}} each that grant 1% progress towards [[Perfection]]. After [[Perfection]] has been completed, Fizz can still be found in the "watery cave", but players will no longer be able to interact with him. Note that a perfection waiver is not an actual in-game item. ==Gifts== Players cannot give gifts to raise friendship points with Fizz. ==Schedule== Fizz can always be found at the [[Ginger Island#Dig Site|Mushroom Cave]] on [[Ginger Island]] from the day after interacting with the [[Qi's Walnut Room#Perfection Tracker|Perfection Tracker]] in Qi's Walnut Room. ==Quotes== {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" ! style="text-align: left;" | '''Initial Mail'''  |- |{{Squote|Hello.
